NHL Team Scoreboard

Source: R/nhl_team_scoreboard.R
nhl_team_scoreboard.Rd

Returns current scoreboard information for a specific team, including upcoming and recent games.

Usage

nhl_team_scoreboard(team_abbr)

Arguments

team_abbr

Three-letter team abbreviation (e.g., "TOR", "BOS")

Value

A named list of data frames: gamesByDate.

gamesByDate

col_nametypesdescription
datecharacterDate the games are scheduled for.
gameslistList of games scheduled on that date.

Examples

# \donttest{
  try(nhl_team_scoreboard(team_abbr = "TOR"))
#> $focusedDate
#> [1] "2026-09-19"
#> 
#> $focusedDateCount
#> [1] 7
#> 
#> $clubTimeZone
#> [1] "America/Toronto"
#> 
#> $clubUTCOffset
#> [1] "-04:00"
#> 
#> $clubScheduleLink
#> [1] "/mapleleafs/schedule"
#> 
#> $gamesByDate
